name: @retroplug/ui-fixture
description: The fixture pack a package's React view is proved by: a real workspace package no product lists, whose one views module defaults a tile view that draws a Box and a Text through @retroplug/ui-react. It is what `pnpm -r typecheck` holds a .tsx to, what rule 3's refusals are copies of, the worked example a new pack's view is copied from, and what test/script/bundle-view-package.test.ts bundles as the UI bundle does; nothing ships it.
